title: Cross-compile a C++ capture app for Zero 2 W (64-bit) and the original Zero

profile.boards: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (64-bit image) and Raspberry Pi Zero W
profile.uses: libcamera-independent V4L2 capture, one external library via pkg-config

prompt: I need to cross-compile my C++ capture app from my Ubuntu PC for both a Zero 2 W (64-bit) and an original Zero W. Give me the toolchain files and the commands.
must: Chooses the ABI from the rootfs bitness: aarch64 for the 64-bit Zero 2 W, an ARMv6 hard-float setup for the Zero W
Warns that a distro arm-linux-gnueabihf toolchain links an ARMv7 libc, so binaries for the Zero W need an ARMv6 toolchain/sysroot (Yocto/Buildroot SDK or crosstool-ng)
Mentions -marm for ARMv6 hard-float on Thumb-default toolchains
Uses a target sysroot with pkg-config restricted to it, and CMake find-root modes
Verifies the result with file and readelf -A (CPU arch tag), and says qemu cannot prove ARMv6 correctness
Keeps one CMake core so Yocto and Buildroot can reuse it (one source, three adapters)
must_not: Uses -mcpu=cortex-a53 flags for the original Zero
Claims the ARMv6 binary was tested without running it on a Zero
Links against host libraries or the distro armhf sysroot for the Zero W
verify: Templates elinux-buildsys-generic/templates/toolchain-*.cmake and Makefile.cross build with the installed cross compilers (tools/validate_skills.py)
